items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: Yes, I played tenor, I think Meyer Weinberg, Gene Meyer was his professional name, played clarinet, Augie Chalang was on drums, and I think Panera was on piano, and I think Cink Martin was on bass.

ctx.x: Who was in that band with Sharpie, huh? When you recorded? Do you remember any of those?

Yes, I played tenor, I think Meyer Weinberg, Gene Meyer was his professional name, played clarinet, Augie Chalang was on drums, and I think Panera was on piano, and I think Cink Martin was on bass. Now I would either have to be Cink Martin or Louis Macenta because Schalke used them almost interchangeably
in those days. Did you name a trombone? Or did he have one?
